description: Stock snapshot per product: rental quantity held, booked, unavailable, on sub-rent and AVAILABLE, plus sale stock and prices. Pass starts_at/ends_at to compute rental availability for a job's dates instead of today, and store_id to restrict to one store. filtermode: active, inactive, all, rental, sale. Current RMS: GET /product_inventories.

ends_at.description: End of the period to compute rental availability for (UTC).

filtermode.description: Built-in filter, e.g. rental, sale, all.

filters.description: Extra Current RMS query-engine predicates, sent as q[<key>]=<value> (arrays become q[<key>][]). Examples: {"updated_at_gt": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}, {"number_eq": "003664"}, {"status_not_eq": 40}, {"work_email_address_eq": "abc@test.com"}, {"asset_number_eq": "ABC-1"}. Unknown predicates are silently ignored by the API.

search.description: Free-text search on name, product group name or tags.

sort.description: Sort order, e.g. ["name asc"] or ["updated_at desc", "id asc"]. Add "id asc" when paging so the order is deterministic.

starts_at.description: Start of the period to compute rental availability for (UTC).

view_id.description: Record id of a saved custom view to apply.

name: current_rms_list_product_inventories
title: List product inventory
